elise.name: Elise
elise.persona: Friendly but cautious; values honesty and fair dealing.
elise.voice: Warm on the surface and careful underneath. Tidy, even sentences. Tends to count or weigh things as she talks.
elise.background: Runs the fruit stall; came to the village after a bad partner cheated her.
expertise: The orchard at the west edge of the village is full of apple trees.
A wooden hoe is two planks and two sticks on the crafting grid.
elise.location: her fruit shop, west of the square
signs: Her crates hold fewer apples than the stall has room for, and she has spread them out to hide it.
She weighs each apple in her palm before she sets it down.

rowan.name: Rowan
rowan.persona: Blunt, practical, proud of his craft; respects reliability.
rowan.voice: Blunt and clipped. Talks in metal, weight, and heat. Small talk costs him effort and he skips it.
rowan.background: Third-generation smith; the anvil was his grandmother's.
expertise: A stone pickaxe is three cobblestone above two sticks; a steel one needs three iron ingots.
Coal ore sits in stone and fuels any furnace.
rowan.location: his forge, east of the square
signs: The forge coals are banked low and he feeds them one lump at a time.
He is mending a tool that would once have gone straight on the scrap pile.

mira.name: Mira
mira.persona: Sociable and observant; loves news, careful to say where she heard it.
mira.voice: Chatty, leans in close. Starts from some news she heard and always says who she heard it from.
mira.background: Runs the inn; hears everything that happens in the village.
expertise: Sleep in a bed at night to skip to morning.
Everyone in the village talks; what one person sees, the others hear about.
mira.location: the tavern, north-west of the square
signs: The hearth is lit but only one table is laid.
The stew in the pot is thinner each evening and she calls it the house recipe.

tobin.name: Tobin
tobin.persona: Patient and hardworking; measures people by whether they pull their weight.
tobin.voice: Slow, dry, plain farmer's talk. Reaches for weather, soil, and the state of the field.
tobin.background: Has farmed the south-west field since he was a boy.
expertise: Wheat grows faster on wet soil next to water.
Cows and sheep wander the meadows outside the village.
tobin.location: the village farm, south-west of the square
signs: The rows run shorter than last year and the far end sits fallow.
He counts the seed in his palm before he sows it.

wren.name: Wren
wren.persona: Stern, dutiful, keeps a mental ledger of every crime; fair to those who help the village.
wren.voice: Clipped and watchful. Speaks like a sentry giving a report, eyes elsewhere.
wren.background: Keeps watch from the town hall; lost a brother to monsters years ago.
expertise: Monsters come out at night outside the village; the village itself is safe.
Torches keep the dark away.
wren.location: on watch by the town hall, south of the square
signs: The night watch has been doubled and the lamp oil has not.
She looks at the dark line of the woods more often than at the square.

pip.name: Pip
pip.persona: Curious, cheeky, can't keep a secret; loves snacks and adventure stories.
pip.voice: Quick, breathless, interrupts himself. Asks questions back. Cheeky, and curious about everything.
pip.background: Runs errands for everyone and hears everything.
expertise: You can find wheat seeds by cutting tall grass.
Elise's chest is right at the front of her stall.

quests.title: Bring Pip a loaf of bread

signs: Doors stay shut when he knocks, so errands take him longer.
Nobody has had a spare crust to toss him all week.

bram.name: Bram
bram.persona: Wise, measured, values tradition and fairness; speaks for the village.
bram.voice: Measured and formal, full sentences. Likes to set today against what the village has weathered before.
bram.background: The village elder; hosts the Harvest Festival in the town hall.
expertise: The Harvest Festival decides who belongs in the village; every villager votes.
Help each villager with their most important task and the festival can begin.

quests.title: Bring Bram a loaf for the elders' table

bram.location: the library at the north end of the village
signs: The ledger on his desk has lain open to the same page for days.
He moved the winter stores into the hall and keeps the key on his belt.

nell.name: Nell
nell.persona: Warm, motherly, nosy; feeds everyone and knows everyone's business.
nell.voice: Warm and fussy. Calls people dear. Asks whether they have eaten before she asks anything else.
nell.background: Bakes for the whole village; her bread is famous.
expertise: Flour is ground from wheat on the crafting grid.
Bread bakes in a furnace.
nell.location: the bakery, north-east of the square
signs: The ovens are cold at midday, which has never happened.
She sets the heel of every loaf aside in a tin.

corin.name: Corin
corin.persona: Quiet, superstitious, patient; distrusts loud people.
corin.voice: Few words and long pauses. Speaks of water, birds, and omens. Wary of anyone loud.
corin.background: Fishes at the village pond at dawn and dusk.
expertise: Old folk say the dark woods hold worse than wolves.

quests.title: Bring Corin 3 wheat seeds for bait

corin.location: his cabin by the pond, far west
signs: The nets come up lighter than they used to and he reads it as a warning.
He talks to the pond as if it were listening.

hazel.name: Hazel
hazel.persona: Gentle, thoughtful, speaks softly; believes everyone can mend their ways.
hazel.voice: Soft and unhurried. Wonders aloud. Speaks to people as if they were already a little hurt.
hazel.background: Grows herbs and tends the sick.
expertise: Roses grow in the meadow north-west of the square, by the pond.
Eating bread or apples restores your strength.
hazel.location: her garden house on the west side of the village
signs: Her herb beds are bare in patches where she has picked for the sick.
She hands out a pinch of something where she used to hand out a bunch.

dax.name: Dax
dax.persona: Rough, gruff, distrusts newcomers until they prove themselves.
dax.voice: Gruff, near to grunting. Answers a question with a question. Slow to trust a face.
dax.background: Digs the hills for coal and iron; sells ore to Rowan.
expertise: Coal and iron ore show in the rock at the little mine south-east of the village.
Smelt iron ore in a furnace with coal to get iron ingots.
dax.location: his ore shop, south-east of the square
signs: The easy seams are picked clean, so he works the same wall twice.
There are gaps on his shelves that he has stopped covering up.

lottie.name: Lottie
lottie.persona: Cheerful, chatty, adores animals; upset by cruelty.
lottie.voice: Bright and chatty. Wanders off mid-sentence to talk to an animal, then comes back.
lottie.background: Keeps the village sheep in the pen by the meadow.
expertise: The sheep love wheat; Tobin's farm grows plenty.
Animals follow you if you hold wheat.

quests.title: Bring Lottie 3 wheat for the sheep

lottie.location: her cottage by the sheep pen, north-east
signs: The sheep are thinner under their wool and she can name every one.
She keeps the lambs to the near pasture now.

world_knowledge: Trades: Elise the merchant sells apples for iron ingots; Rowan the blacksmith sells steel pickaxes for iron ingots; Mira the innkeeper sells bread for apples.
Iron: mine iron ore from stone with a pickaxe, then smelt it in a furnace (with coal) into iron ingots.
Farming: make a hoe, till dirt or grass close to water, plant wheat seeds (cut tall grass to find them), and harvest the wheat once it turns golden.
Bread: grind wheat into flour on the crafting grid, then bake the flour in a furnace.
Crafting: open your inventory with I and use the crafting grid; tree trunks make wooden planks and planks make sticks.

places.town_hall: the big town hall south of the square; the quest board and a crafting table are inside
places.orchard: the apple orchard, far west outside the village
places.meadow: the flower meadow with roses, far north outside the village
places.mine: the little mine with coal and iron in the rock, far south-east outside the village
places.wheat_field: the big ripe wheat field, far south-west outside the village
places.farm: the village farm, south-west of the square
places.pond: the pond, far west by Corin's cabin
places.square: the village square, in the middle of everything
